Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(max_depth=0, respect_robots_txt=False)
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result.status_code)
    print(result.content_type)
    print(result.html)
    print(result.metadata.title)
    print(result.metadata.description)
    print(result.metadata.canonical_url)
    print(len(result.links))
    print(result.links[0].link_type)
    print(len(result.images))
    print(result.metadata.og_title)

asyncio.run(main())
```
